title: Lump Sum Investment
shortText: Invest a bonus, inheritance or maturity proceeds in one go.
whatItIs: A lump-sum investment puts a one-time amount into a mutual fund scheme at the day's NAV. It is often used for bonuses, maturity proceeds or savings already accumulated. For equity schemes, some investors choose to deploy a large sum gradually through a Systematic Transfer Plan from a liquid fund to reduce timing risk.
whoItSuits: Investors with a sizeable amount available today who have a clear time horizon and understand that equity values can fall in the short term.
howItWorks: Discuss the amount, goal and time horizon with your relationship manager
Choose a scheme or a liquid fund with an STP into equity
Pay online by UPI or net banking
Units are allotted at the applicable NAV and appear on your dashboard

faqs.question: Is lump sum better than SIP?
faqs.answer: Neither is better in every situation; it depends on whether you have the money now, your time horizon and your comfort with short-term volatility.

faqs.question: What is an STP?
faqs.answer: A Systematic Transfer Plan moves a fixed amount at regular intervals from one scheme to another scheme of the same AMC.
